name: mybus
description: This website describes upcoming bus service changes for LA Metro. Starting 6/2024, parse:data is used to parse the data from Google Sheets.

scripts.fetch:data-lines: node get-route-data.js || echo 'Warning: get-route-data.js failed; continuing build without updated lines data.'
scripts.fetch:data: npm run fetch:data-updates && npm run fetch:data-content && npm run fetch:data-lines
scripts.clean:build: npm run clean && npm run fetch:data && npm run parse:data && npm run build
scripts.clean:serve: npm run clean:build && npm run serve
